name: Camden County, NJ
findings: Camden County has 1,716 nonprofit organizations. 695 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 549 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Camden County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few political organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 political organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through political groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 professional organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 174 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 174 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
